body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ''SPD-50P7HDT'', HD-ready wall-mount wireless PDP TV during KES 2006, which can receive HD signals wirelessly without AV port through a set-up box. It features a contrast ratio of 10,000:1 and a brightness of 1300cd/m.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
